title: Network Bulletin: Cash Pickup Correction Extension After Name-Mismatch Refusals
content:
When a recipient's name is corrected on a Cash Pickup transfer, the last day of collection moves later by the correction extension. The extension is worked out from the correction guarantee, which is the number of days of collection the transfer is guaranteed after a name correction. How it is worked out follows the pickups refused on the transfer because the name on the ID did not match.

## Terms

- **Days left.** The calendar days from the day of the correction to the current last day of collection. The correction day is not counted.
- **Top-up.** The correction guarantee less the days left, never below zero.
- **Days lost.** The calendar days from the most recent name-mismatch refusal to the day of the correction. The refusal day is not counted.

## Decision table

| Pickups refused because the name on the ID did not match | Correction extension |
|---|---|
| two or more | the larger of the top-up and the days lost |
| exactly one | the top-up, with the days lost given back on top of it |
| none | the top-up alone, which is zero when the days left already reach the guarantee |

The extension is a whole number of calendar days, never below zero. The last day of collection moves later by that number of days.

## Worked cases (hypothetical guarantee of 10 days)

| Days left | Top-up | Days lost since the latest name refusal | Two or more refusals | Exactly one refusal | No refusal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 6 | 9 | 9 | 15 | 6 |
| 12 | 0 | 9 | 9 | 9 | 0 |
| 7 | 3 | 2 | 3 | 5 | 3 |

Refusals for other reasons do not count here. Those reasons are an expired ID, no valid ID shown, a wrong Pickup Number, and a location without cash.
